description: This file provides utility functions for resolving shell paths, detecting runtime shells, and sanitizing binary output, primarily used for managing shell environments and execution in a cross-platform Node.js application.

methods.name: resolvePowerShellPath
methods.description: Determines the path to PowerShell, preferring PowerShell 7 if available, with fallback options based on environment variables and system paths.

methods.name: getShellConfig
methods.description: Returns the shell executable and arguments to use for spawning a shell, with special handling for Windows and common Unix shells.

methods.name: resolveShellFromPath
methods.description: Searches the system PATH for an executable with the given name and returns its full path if found and executable.

methods.name: normalizeShellName
methods.description: Normalizes a shell name string by trimming, removing extensions, and sanitizing characters.

methods.name: detectRuntimeShell
methods.description: Detects the current runtime shell based on environment variables and platform specifics.

methods.name: sanitizeBinaryOutput
methods.description: Removes formatting and surrogate characters from binary output text to produce a clean string.
